CMR.note: A dedicated AI authority and legal framework are only announced, with no draft or decree; IGF recommendations are not a rule.
ST Digital is only relied on to deliver the strategy; no AI system is stated as piloted or in service.
Priority sectors are named; the only tool named, Healthlane, is a private startup's.

facts.fact: OBS-CC's tracker says Cameroon's National AI Development Strategy (SNIA, seven pillars, horizon 2040) was presented and adopted at the national consultations in Yaounde, and notes no public full text has been found.

CMR.note: A local-language large language model is only announced, with no builder or funder named.

facts.fact: OBS-CC says the government, under the World Bank-funded PATNUC project, launched the online platform train.patnucelearning.cm to train 15,000 public officials in AI, blockchain and digital transformation.

CMR.note: Only a private AI data centre investment intention in Douala is mentioned, with funding unconfirmed.
Sovereign solutions are an aim of the strategy; no data localisation rule is stated.
No national data centre is stated.

facts.fact: OBS-CC says the National AI Strategy was presented and adopted at the national AI consultations (CONIA) in Yaounde, which bring together the State, universities, the private sector and local authorities.

CMR.note: Startups are mentioned without any public startup law, labelling or fund.
The Cameroon Digital Innovation Center is mentioned only as a competition venue.
